1.note: The platinum follows the other 54; there is no shortcut. Work the roadmap in order and it arrives last.
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies.
The platinum unlocks automatically when the last one lands.
Play the story until Child's Play appears, then complete it.
Play the story until Headliners appears, then complete it.

12.note: A story mission at the airport.
steps: Play the story until VCIA Takedown appears, then complete it.
Play the story until Operation Savage Glory appears, then complete it.

14.note: The long one: 100% means story, stranger strands, activities, collectibles and the counts this guide tracks. Treat it as the last trophy before the platinum.
steps: Finish the story and every stranger strand.
Clear the activity and collectible checklists in this guide.
Check the in-game 100% tracker for what is left.

15.note: Stunts count wherever you land them: jumps, near misses, airtime. They accumulate across the whole game.
steps: Use fast bikes and cars on ramps, hills and jumps.
Chain airtime and near misses; the counter keeps count.

16.note: The 9 activity types are the ones this guide lists under Activities: races, fishing, arcade, bowling, meditation, hunting, shooting range, drone races and stunts. One try of each is enough.
steps: Try one of each activity type once.
Use the Activities filter in this guide to see which you have tried.

17.note: 42 challenges, each needing a gold medal. Learn each challenge's weapon and par time before grinding it.
steps: Open the Shooting Range and work through the 42 challenges.
Replay any challenge until it shows a gold medal.

18.note: 14 drone-race locations. A win at each one counts; you do not need to win them all in one sitting.
steps: Find the Top Fun drone races on the map.
Win one race at each of the 14 locations.

19.note: Any 20 different races count — street, off-road, boat and air all count toward the same total.
steps: Enter races from the map and win 20 different ones.
Vary the race type so you are not repeating the same event.

2.note: The opening mission. Unmissable as long as you play the story.
steps: Start a new game and play the opening mission, Gone Fishing.
Follow the on-screen prompts through the mission.

20.note: A fishing duel against Cal. The challenge is a timed catch count, so fish where the challenge says and mind the line tension.
steps: Find Cal's fishing challenge.
Beat his catch count before the timer ends.

21.note: Any arcade cabinet counts. Pick a short game and finish a full run.
steps: Find an arcade and start any game.
Play it through to its end screen.

22.note: Andy's strand ends with his final mission; stranger and contact strands appear as icons on the map.
steps: Follow Andy's missions until his final one appears, then complete it.

23.note: Kenton's strand ends with his final mission.
steps: Follow Kenton's missions until his final one appears, then complete it.

24.note: Billy's strand ends with his final mission.
steps: Follow Billy's missions until his final one appears, then complete it.

25.note: Stranger strands are the small mission chains marked on the map across Leonida. Eight of them must be finished end to end.
steps: Visit stranger icons as they appear across the state.
Complete 8 full strands, not just their first missions.

26.note: Randy's strand ends with his final mission.
steps: Follow Randy's missions until his final one appears, then complete it.

27.note: Tyrone's strand ends with his final mission.
steps: Follow Tyrone's missions until his final one appears, then complete it.

28.note: 18 meditation spots are scattered across Leonida — beaches, hilltops and quiet corners. The map marks them once you get close.
steps: Find a meditation spot and meditate there.
Repeat at all 18 spots.

29.note: Bret points you at a unique animal. Track it with the hunting clues rather than wandering.
steps: Talk to Bret and follow his lead to the animal's area.
Track it down and take the shot.

3.note: Story progress only. If you finish every mission the chapter offers, this lands on its own.
steps: Complete every mission in Chapter 1.
The trophy pops when the chapter closes.

30.note: Collectible cards are hidden around Leonida; sets complete when every card in a set is found. Three finished sets are enough.
steps: Pick up collectible cards as you explore.
Complete any 3 full sets.

31.note: WAiNK It spots are the spray-tag locations. 100 of them are spread over the whole map, so work district by district.
steps: Find WAiNK It spots and tag them.
Keep going until 100 locations are done.

32.note: Challenges are the small objectives the game lists per activity — any mix of 50 counts.
steps: Open the challenges list and clear 50 of them.
Mix easy ones (races, stunts) with longer ones.

33.missable_note: Do this while your partner is available for free-roam activities. Partner availability narrows late in the story, so do not leave it until after the finale.
33.note: Get a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then lose the cops and escape. A fast car and a quiet corner of the map help.
steps: Bring your partner along and raise your wanted level to 4 stars.
Break line of sight, lose the search, and escape.

34.missable_note: Needs your partner present and a wanted level that survives three robberies in a row. Do it before the story's final stretch, while the partner is still around.
34.note: Pick three shops close together, rob them one after another, and keep the wanted level alive between them.
steps: Plan a route past three nearby shops.
Rob all three back-to-back with your partner, without losing the wanted level.

35.note: Discovering means entering or driving a vehicle type for the first time. Variety beats repetition — try boats, planes, bikes and trucks, not just cars.
steps: Drive or enter new vehicle types as you find them.
Check the discovery count in the stats to see what is left.

36.note: Combat Focus slows time. Use it in a crowded firefight so five enemies are in range at once.
steps: Enter a firefight with several enemies grouped together.
Trigger Combat Focus and down 5 of them before it ends.

37.missable_note: The unscheduled departure is tied to the VCIA storyline — a one-time window. Do it when the airport missions are live, not after they are done.
37.note: At VCIA, take a plane and leave without clearance. Expect a wanted level on the way out.
steps: Go to VCIA during the airport missions.
Board a plane and depart without a scheduled flight.

38.missable_note: Rhinos (tanks) show up in specific missions. When one appears, deal with it there — free-roam tanks are rare.
38.note: Use heavy weapons or sticky bombs on the Rhino; small arms will not do it.
steps: When a Rhino appears in a mission, attack it with heavy weapons.
Finish the encounter to bank the trophy.

39.note: Stealth is the whole job: enter quiet, keep the staff calm, leave before the alarm. A silenced approach and a fast exit help.
steps: Pick a jewelry store and enter without raising the alarm.
Take the goods and leave undetected.
Complete every mission in Chapter 2.
The trophy pops when the chapter closes.

40.note: Five bank vaults, each a robbery and an escape. Plan the getaway car before you walk in.
steps: Rob a bank vault and escape the police.
Repeat for 5 vaults.
Complete every mission in Chapter 3.
The trophy pops when the chapter closes.
Complete every mission in Chapter 4.
The trophy pops when the chapter closes.

7.note: The story finale. Do the missable partner trophies (33, 34) before the finale if you have not yet — partner availability narrows late in the story.
steps: Play through to the final mission and finish it.

8.note: A story mission. It appears in the mission list once the story reaches it.
steps: Play the story until Breakfast Run appears, then complete it.
Play the story until The Cartel Heist appears, then complete it.

41.note: Armored trucks run set routes. Hijack one, break the escort, and escape before the police box you in.
steps: Find an armored truck on its route.
Hijack it and escape with the cargo.

42.note: 52 named areas cover the whole state. The map shades each one as you visit it, so the gaps show you where to go.
steps: Drive through every named area of Leonida.
Check the map for unvisited regions.

43.note: Nine gangs, one illegal operation each. The operations are marked once you scout a gang's territory.
steps: Find an illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs.
Rob one operation per gang.

44.note: A quiet moment on Ocean Beach. Find the bar with the view, order the cocktail, and enjoy it.
steps: Go to Ocean Beach and find the bar with the view.
Order a cocktail there.

45.note: Drive a car through a vehicle showroom's front in classic style. Any showroom works; mind the wanted level after.
steps: Pick a vehicle showroom.
Smash your way out of it in a car.

46.note: Bowling at the Kolt & Associates alley. A full game counts as a follow-through.
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Play a full game of bowling.

47.missable_note: A story beat about the partnership. It happens once, at the moment the story serves it — do not skip the scene.
47.note: Play the story until the partnership moment arrives and see it through.
steps: Follow the story to the partnership moment.
Complete the scene it opens.

48.missable_note: The game tracks choices up to a count of 500, and choices cannot be undone. Make them deliberately across the whole playthrough; a fresh save cannot re-make a spent choice.
48.note: Choices appear in missions and in free roam. Keep choosing and the count climbs.
steps: Make story and free-roam choices as they come.
Keep going until the tracked count reaches 500.

49.missable_note: A second try is only possible where the game lets you retry. When you fail something, take the retry instead of reloading an old save.
49.note: Fail an objective, then succeed on the immediate retry.
steps: Fail an objective that offers a retry.
Succeed on the second attempt.

50.missable_note: A random strange event. Roam the odd corners of Leonida — deserts, swamps, back roads at night — and keep your eyes open; it may not repeat.
50.note: Something strange happens somewhere in Leonida. Wander the map's quiet places until it finds you.
steps: Explore Leonida's remote and unusual spots.
When the strange event triggers, see it through.

51.note: A drive-by with a melee weapon. Slow down beside a pedestrian, swing, and keep driving.
steps: Get a melee weapon and a car.
Drive by a pedestrian and knock them down with the melee swing.

52.note: Marked bills come from heists and robberies; your contacts launder them for a cut. $250,000 in total is the target.
steps: Earn marked bills from robberies and heists.
Launder them through your contacts until $250,000 is clean.

53.note: $100,000 across all shops: weapons, clothes, cars, food. Big purchases count fastest.
steps: Spend money in shops across Leonida.
Keep going until the total passes $100,000.

54.note: Eight garage properties are for sale around the state. Buy them all to store the fleet.
steps: Find the garage properties for sale.
Buy all 8 of them.

55.note: The Scooter Bros app registers vehicles you own or find. Ten registrations is the target.
steps: Open the Scooter Bros app.
Register 10 vehicles to it.
